summary: Donation/badge removal feature verified: backend suite (113 pytest incl. tiers/admin-confirm/checkout/status/webhook), yarn typecheck, vitest (73 tests) all green. 7 browser checks covering profile badge catalog, donation page copy, success page, admin review UI, and migration review.
action_items: Migration 041 is a Supabase SQL draft under docs/migrations/ — it must be run by the user in Lovable's SQL editor; it was not and cannot be executed by the agent (external managed DB).
Stripe account is in STRIPE_MODE=test per backend/.env; live money cannot be verified/claimed by source code alone — this is an environment/business limitation, not a code defect.

checks.criterion: Stripe tier API has no badge/test-mode fields
checks.name: test_tscheck_payments_tiers.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/payments/tiers -> 200, body keys == {tiers, custom_min_cents, custom_max_cents}; 6 tiers supporter..founder with exact amount_cents (100..10000) and no badge field; re-verified with direct curl.

checks.criterion: Admin Stripe review no longer writes Supabase donations
checks.name: test_tscheck_payments_admin.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/payments/admin/donations/<sid>/confirm on a fixture Mongo doc (payment_status=paid, credit_status=open) -> 200, credit_status=credited; second call -> 409 (idempotent); list endpoint returns the created doc. No Supabase /rest/v1/donations call exists in routers/payments.py (code-reviewed, 3 pytest files: admin/checkout/status/webhook, 113 total pass).

checks.criterion: Donation badge catalog removed from app
checks.name: profile-badges-only-community-section
checks.evidence: Mocked logged-in /profil: section text matches COMMUNITY-ABZEICHEN only, no UNTERSTÜTZER text; badge-{supporter,bronze,silver,gold,diamond,founder} all count 0; badge-donate-link count 0; badge-first_find (community) still visible.

checks.criterion: Donation page no longer contains badge or test-donation messaging
checks.name: spenden-page-no-badge-messaging
checks.evidence: /spenden body text contains 'Stripe' + support wording, has 0 donate-test-mode-hint elements, no match for Testmodus/test mode/4242/Abzeichen/badge; 0 inside donate-tier-* buttons (amount-only cards).

checks.criterion: Donation page no longer contains badge or test-donation messaging (regression vs prior hint)
checks.name: donate-page-guest-hints
checks.evidence: Updated stale pre-change check (previously asserted the test-mode hint WAS visible); now asserts donate-test-mode-hint has count 0 and guest login link / cancelled hint still render correctly.

checks.criterion: Donation success page no badge message
checks.name: donate-thanks-success-no-badge-message
checks.evidence: Mocked /api/payments/status/* -> payment_status=paid; donate-thanks-success visible; full page text has no match for /admin/i or /Abzeichen|badge/i.

checks.criterion: Admin Stripe review no longer writes Supabase donations (UI)
checks.name: admin-stripe-donations-no-badge-text
checks.evidence: Mocked admin session + /api/payments/admin/donations (open) and confirm endpoint: section text has no /Abzeichen|badge/i, button reads 'Als geprüft markieren', clicking it calls the confirm endpoint exactly once and list re-renders as credited.

checks.name: spenden-public-preview-no-badge
checks.evidence: Via public preview URL https://leonida-karte--6tt5kohx.preview.emergentagent.com/spenden: donate-page visible, donate-test-mode-hint count 0, no Testmodus/badge text in body.

checks.name: yarn typecheck + vitest + pytest suite
checks.evidence: `yarn typecheck` -> tsc clean; `yarn vitest run` -> 9 files / 73 tests passed; `cd backend && python -m pytest -q` -> 113 passed (includes payments tiers/checkout/status/webhook/admin and unrelated sql/push/community suites), no BadgeKind donation regressions.

notes: Migration file docs/migrations/041_spenden_und_spendenabzeichen_entfernen.sql reviewed by reading content: drops trigger donations_badges + function sync_donation_badges, cleans featured_badges array of donation badge ids, deletes user_badges rows referencing kind='donation' badges, deletes all public.donations rows, deletes badges where kind='donation'. It does not touch Mongo payment_transactions and does not drop any collections/tables — matches the acceptance criterion. Not executed (external Supabase/Lovable DB per briefing; executing it is explicitly the user's responsibility and out of scope for this agent).

src/lib/badges.ts BadgeKind type is now 'community' only (no donation entries) confirming the catalog removal at the source level; vitest/typecheck green confirms no leftover references broke the build.

No test_credentials exist for Supabase auth (confirmed via /app/memory/test_credentials.md and SQL comments) — all authenticated browser checks used the established repo pattern of localStorage-seeded Supabase JWT sessions + mocked Supabase/FastAPI routes, consistent with every other check already in this suite.
